{"claim_id": "c2", "code": "import torch, importlib.util, numpy as np, struct, json, math
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("k", "/root/cases/case_148/kernel.py")
k = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(k)

vals = [17.0, 17.25, 17.5, 17.75, 18.0, 20.0, 100.0, 65504.0,
        -6.0, -7.0, -8.0, -8.3, -8.4, -9.0, -11.1, -12.0, -17.0, -20.0, -65504.0,
        0.0, -0.0, 6.0, 5.96e-8, -6.0]
x = torch.tensor(vals, dtype=torch.float16, device="cuda")
out = k.run(x)

def bits16(t):
    return (t.view(torch.int16).to(torch.int64).cpu().numpy() & 0xFFFF).tolist()

kb = bits16(out)
# contract reference: CPU FP64 sigmoid -> binary16 RNE via struct (kernel's own reference())
rb = bits16(k.reference(x).cpu())

# also independent high-precision check for these extremes via exact reasoning is not needed:
# FP64 sigmoid error (~1e-16) is far below the distances of these sigmoid values from FP16 tie points
mism = [i for i in range(len(vals)) if kb[i] != rb[i]]
res = {"inputs": [float(v) for v in x.cpu()],
       "kernel_bits_hex": [hex(b) for b in kb],
       "ref_bits_hex": [hex(b) for b in rb],
       "mismatches": mism,
       "x=65504_kernel": hex(kb[8 - 0]) if False else hex(kb[vals.index(65504.0)]),
       "zeros_0x3800": kb[19] == 0x3800 and kb[20] == 0x3800,
       "large_neg_below_8.32_is_0x3B80": all(kb[i] == 0x3B80 for i, v in enumerate(vals) if v <= -8.4),
       "large_pos_above_17.32_is_zero": all(kb[i] == 0x0000 for i, v in enumerate(vals) if v >= 17.5)}
print(json.dumps(res))
", "expected_signal": "explicit tail bit patterns: zeros -> 0x3800, x>=17.5 -> 0x0000, x<=-8.4 -> 0x3B80, and kernel == struct.pack FP64 reference for all listed extremes; any real mismatch (vs ref, not my thresholds) confirms, else rebutted", "timeout_s": 120}
